reviews.text: Dallas and his team are very good at keeping our pool in great shape! We recently had him renovate our entire pool and spa and we are very pleased with the outcome. It's as if we have a whole new pool in our backyard. It's now the beautiful centerpiece of our yard and no longer the ugly duckling. We highly recommend D's Pool Care for all your pool care needs!
reviews.author: Janet Leski

reviews.text: Dallas refinished my pool and then has been taking care of my pool for 4 years.   He provides great service at a great value.  I can text him with problems and issues and he will promptly respond.
reviews.author: Eric Borton

reviews.text:
You want this guy!

Full disclosure...he was high bid but absolutely worth it!

I am very particular and detail-oriented but Dallas and his crews really impressed me.  No detail was overlooked and they went the extra-mile to make our pool look incredible!

The tile and stone work were extremely precise.(See photos)  We have a curved pool and weren't sure how it was going to turn out, but we couldn't be more pleased!

In addition to the quality work, Dallas and his crews were punctual, transparent, and accommodating.  It's rare to find quality work and great customer service, but these guys knocked it out of the park!

If you are trying to do a pool reno on a budget, I would strongly recommend hiring a quality operation like D's and only cry once with quality!  Worth every penny!

I will definitely be recommending Dallas and his crews to family and friends, but their work speaks for itself!  Great follow-up communications as well!

A huge thank you to Dallas and his crews!  Well done!
reviews.author: Danny M

reviews.text: Mr. Dodson did a complete remodel on our pool  -  new pebbled surface, new fixtures, etc.  We had called on him before for repairs to the filter and pump and knew he was a good man to work with.  His people were great  -  on time, very professional, and hard-working.  It has always been the same with Dodson himself.  The pool looks great and we're very happy with the results.  Highly recommend D's Pool service.
reviews.author: Thomas Routt

reviews.text: Dallas and his staff are Amazing. Reasonable cost for top notch service. My pool is always beautiful and equipment runs great. They are very responsive to all my questions. Most knowledgeable and friendly pool care company  i have had in 35 years.We Very much appreciate you Ds pool care!
reviews.author: David Bashor

reviews.text: I have used D’s Pool Care for years. Dallas Dodson is great! He and his team are knowledgeable and professional, and the prices are reasonable. Recently, during the freezing weather, my yard service accidentally broke a pipe on the pool equipment. Dallas fixed it quickly, knowing that I needed the equipment to be on to prevent freeze damage. My hero! I will always use D’s Pool Care!
reviews.author: Darelyn Jennings

reviews.text: We’ve been using Dallas and his team for our full service pool care for about 5 years now. We have 4 acres here and we board approx 15-20 horses out back at a time just right on the other side of our pool fence. With that many horses plus horse arena, keeping a pool like ours clean can be quite a challenge, but Tommy (our pool guy) does a great job keeping our pool in great shape and looking nice. We highly recommend D's for your pool care needs.
reviews.author: Hayden Brian Templeton

reviews.text:
We have been blessed to have D’s Pool Care servicing our swimming pool for over a decade. We’ve always had swimming pools and did our own maintenance. We never really mastered the craft but didn’t think hiring it done was the best use of our budget. Boy, were we wrong! When we retired, and decided to travel, we knew we wouldn’t be home enough to keep it up; we met with Dallas and signed an agreement in 2012. We have never had a single problem. The occasional “hiccup” is always resolved quickly with a text or phone call. Thank goodness for our technician, Tommy. He knows our pool and keeps it looking great. He’s always on time and he’s very thorough and professional.
If you’re thinking about pool service D’s Pool Service is the answer.
reviews.author: Sharon Orsborn
